description: This file contains unit tests for the internal implementation of unordered_set modifiers in the Abseil C++ library, using Google Test framework.

classes.name: ModifiersTest
classes.description: A templated test fixture class for testing unordered_set modifier functions.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Tests the clear() method of the unordered set.

methods.name: Insert
methods.description: Tests the insert() method for inserting a single element.

methods.name: InsertHint
methods.description: Tests the insert() method with a hint iterator.

methods.name: InsertRange
methods.description: Tests inserting a range of elements.

methods.name: InsertWithinCapacity
methods.description: Tests inserting an element without increasing bucket count.

methods.name: InsertRangeWithinCapacity
methods.description: Tests inserting a range of elements within capacity constraints.

methods.name: EmplaceHint
methods.description: Tests emplacing an element with a hint iterator.

methods.name: Erase
methods.description: Tests erasing an element via iterator.

methods.name: EraseRange
methods.description: Tests erasing a range of elements.

methods.name: EraseKey
methods.description: Tests erasing an element by key.
